hooks.name: Decision Trail
hooks.description: Append one decision-log row per agent turn to decisions.tsv, following the show-me-your-work format.

action.prompt:
You are appending a decision-trail row for the turn that just finished, in the show-me-your-work TSV format.

SCOPE CHECK first: if the turn made no real decision, fork, unit completion, pivot, revert, or blocker, STOP and write nothing. Skip trivial and self-evident turns.

IF the turn had a loggable decision, append to decisions.tsv in the work dir (create it with the header row `ts\tphase\tdecision\twhy\tevidence\tresult` if absent):

- ts: current local time in ISO8601.
- phase: the phase or workstream.
- decision: what was chosen or done, one line.
- why: the reason in plain words, no jargon tag.
- evidence: a pointer that resolves (commit SHA, PR number, file:line, artifact path), never prose.
- result: the outcome (tests green, reverted, open, INCONCLUSIVE).

RULES: append-only, never edit or delete history. Keep every cell single-line. Prefix any cell starting with =, +, -, or @ with a single quote. Never write secrets; refer to them by key name. Only modify decisions.tsv.
